after_notes: Sealed exact-package Ultra 205 evidence binds the conservative 400 MHz, 1100 mV, and 100% fan profile; all nine ordered preparation steps; fresh safety and post-command RPM admission; 500 ms stabilization; active-low ASIC enable; exactly one BM1366; mining-ready completion; retained production UART; accepted work; eight-step rollback semantics; safe stop; cleanup; source compatibility; independent validation; redaction; and no hardware rerun. See [PWR-002 result](work-plans/20260812T193941Z-PWR-002/RESULT.md) and [power-initialization projection](evidence/pwr002-asic-power-initialization/power-initialization-projection.json). Analog accuracy, electrical waveforms, arbitrary profiles, automatic fan behavior, injected physical faults, thermal response, soak stability, other ASICs or boards, updates, recovery, and release readiness remain non-claims. Later soak evidence (ADR-0037), outside the projection above, narrows the arbitrary-profile, automatic-fan and soak-stability non-claims for these cases only: the device-settings profiles 485 MHz / 1200 mV ([soak 007](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-007.md)) and 575 MHz / 1200 mV ([soak 009](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-009.md)) each prepared with the fan at 100% and then mined 600 s under the automatic fan; a third soak mined 485/1200 with 200 s at 400/1100 ([soak 008](evidence/20261016-ultra205-soak-008.md)). The 1300 mV corner, other profiles and fan settings, and the remaining non-claims above still apply.
